code:
-- Record syntax: named fields
data Person = Person
    { firstName :: String
    , lastName  :: String
    , age       :: Int
    } deriving (Show)

-- Construction:
alice = Person { firstName = "Alice", lastName = "Smith", age = 30 }

-- Access by field name:
Prelude> firstName alice    -- "Alice"
Prelude> age alice          -- 30

-- Update (creates a new value; nothing is mutated):
older_alice = alice { age = 31 }
description: A record gives names to a value's fields. You can construct, inspect, and update a Person through those names.

steps.description: Person declares firstName, lastName, and age with their types.
You construct alice by supplying a value for each named field.
Field names also serve as accessor functions. These expressions read fields from alice.
The record update creates older_alice with a changed age. alice keeps its original value.
